description: Search companies by name in the registry of any supported country: name, registration number, status, address and link. 2 points per returned record.

country.description: Country. Options: AR = Argentina (IGJ), AU = Australia (ASIC/ABN), AT = Austria (Firmenbuch), BE = Belgium (KBO/BCE), BR = Brazil (CNPJ), BG = Bulgaria (Commercial Register), CA = Canada (Corporations Canada), CO = Colombia (RUES), HR = Croatia (Sudski registar), CY = Cyprus (DRCOR), CZ = Czech Republic (Justice.cz), DK = Denmark (CVR), EC = Ecuador (Superintendencia de Compañías), EE = Estonia (e-Business Register), FI = Finland (PRH/YTJ), FR = France (RNE), GE = Georgia (NAPR), IL = Israel (Corporations Authority), LV = Latvia (Register of Enterprises), LU = Luxembourg (RCS/LBR), MX = Mexico (PSM), NL = Netherlands (KVK), NZ = New Zealand (Companies Register), NO = Norway (Enhetsregisteret), PA = Panama (Registro Público), PL = Poland (KRS), PT = Portugal (Registo Comercial), RO = Romania (ONRC), SK = Slovakia (Obchodný register), SI = Slovenia (AJPES/PRS), KR = South Korea (DART), ES = Spain (Registro Mercantil), SE = Sweden (Bolagsverket), TW = Taiwan (MOEA), GB = United Kingdom (Companies House) Default: GB.

status.description: Status. Options: active = Active, inactive = Inactive / dissolved

name: run_registry_companies_search
title: Company registries search
